text: CareBridge General Hospital — Operational Guidelines Emergency Department Overview & Scope: Emergency procedures, triage categories, admission process, and emergency response protocols. 1. Purpose and Scope This document outlines the standard operating procedures, policies, and clinical workflows for the Emergency Department at CareBridge General Hospital. All staff members are required to strictly adhere to these protocols to ensure optimal patient safety and service excellence. 2. Operational Procedures & Workflows  Initial Assessment & Intake: Every patient presenting to this department undergoes immediate intake logging and preliminary screening according to hospital triage standards.  Resource Allocation & Execution: Department personnel utilize integrated electronic health records (EHR) to track procedures, monitor vital parameters, and coordinate with interdepartmental specialists.  Safety & Compliance Checks: Mandatory dual-verification protocols are enforced for high-risk operations, medication administration, and specimen handling. 3. Documentation and Reporting All clinical interventions, administrative requests, and incident reports must be documented in the central database within two hours of completion. Discrepancies or adverse events must be reported directly to the department supervisor and the Quality Assurance Committee. 4. Contact & Escalation For urgent clinical escalation, contact the On-Call Department Head via hospital comms channel 4. For system or operational support, submit a ticket through the internal IT/Operations portal.
